data.exact_reserve_text: The provisions for these claims established at the previous year-end compared to the present estimated ultimate costs of these claims has enabled a release of reserves as at 31 December 2014 of GBP 16.7m (2013: GBP 10.0m release). GBP 8.1m of this release relates to the class of business fire and other damage to property.

prior_year_events.event_name: Favourable development on 2011 and prior years
prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of reserves due to very favourable incurred claims development on 2011 and prior years (enabling a GBP 16.7m release at 31 December 2014).
Claims arising out of Superstorm Sandy are stable and as expected.

named_events.loss_description: claims arising out of Superstorm Sandy are stable and as expected.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year reserve release of GBP 16.7m at 31 December 2014 driven by very favourable incurred claims development on 2011 and earlier underwriting years and lighter-than-expected utilisation of IBNR. Approximately GBP 8.1m of the release related to the fire and other damage to property class. Separately, claims from Superstorm Sandy (2012) are reported as stable and in line with expectations.
raw_causal_phrases: substantial release of reserves for prior years now available due to the very favourable trends experienced during 2014 in incurred claims development on all the years of 2011 and prior.
The utilisation of the reserve for incurred but not reported claims has been lighter than in any year of recent times.
has enabled a release of reserves as at 31 December 2014 of GBP 16.7m (2013: GBP 10.0m release). GBP 8.1m of this release relates to the class of business fire and other damage to property.
claims arising out of Superstorm Sandy are stable and as expected.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative (explicit). Prior-year development amount (GBP 16.7m release) is taken from narrative note (explicit sentence) rather than a detailed 'movement in prior years' table; no gross claims development triangle was present in the provided extract to cross-check. The GBP 8.1m allocation to 'fire and other damage to property' is explicitly stated. No detailed per-LOB prior-year movement breakdown beyond the fire figure was provided.
